title: RabbitMQ Publisher
description: Business, HTTP, .NET runtime and PostgreSQL metrics of rabbitmqpublisher-dotnet (OpenTelemetry Prometheus exporter).

panels.title: Published
panels.description: Messages published and confirmed by RabbitMQ in the selected time range.

panels.title: Publish failures
panels.description: Messages RabbitMQ could not publish or confirm. They stay stored with published = false and can be republished.

panels.title: Failure ratio
panels.description: Failures / (published + failures).

targets.expr: (sum(increase(publisher_messages_publish_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(publisher_messages_published_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(publisher_messages_publish_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key"}[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Duplicates rejected
panels.description: Publish requests rejected with 409 because the same payload, type and routing key already exist.

panels.title: Processed
panels.description: Messages reported as processed by a consumer.

panels.title: Errors registered
panels.description: Errors reported by consumers through POST /api/error.

panels.title: p95 confirm time
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time RabbitMQ took to confirm a message.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Scrape targets of the API that Prometheus can reach.

panels.title: Published per minute
panels.description: Messages published and confirmed, by routing key and operation (publish or republish).

panels.title: Publish failures per minute
panels.description: Messages RabbitMQ could not publish or confirm.

panels.title: Published vs processed per minute
panels.description: If published stays above processed, consumers are falling behind or failing.

panels.title: Duplicates rejected per minute
panels.description: Retries or repeated requests stopped by the idempotency check.

panels.title: Confirm time percentiles
panels.description: Time RabbitMQ took to accept and confirm a message (publisher confirms).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Confirm time p95 by routing key

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, routing_key) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Requests per second by route and status
panels.description: Health checks and metric scrapes are excluded.

panels.title: Error responses ratio
panels.description: 4xx includes expected business answers such as 404 (unknown routing key) and 409 (duplicate).

panels.title: Latency p95 by route
panels.description: Requests to unknown routes (404 without a matched route) are shown as (no route).

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route!~"/health.*|/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))), "http_route", "(no route)", "http_route", "")

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Share of the available CPUs used by the process.

panels.title: Thread pool
panels.description: A growing queue means requests are waiting for threads.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: Idle and used connections of the Npgsql pool. The pool maximum is db_client_connection_max (100 by default).

panels.title: Query duration
panels.description: Query duration percentiles (left axis) and queries per second (right axis).
